summary: WI-06g lands the section 43 accessibility controls as one independently testable behavior: five settings-UI controls (master volume slider, screen shake toggle, reduced flashing toggle, radio-message subtitles, high-contrast sonar option) wired into existing audio/render/sonar paths and persisted through a versioned save-settings round-trip. Exactly three named changed subsystems, a strict subset of ST-06's four (world content data excluded), within the three-responsibility leaf limit; the save-settings schema extension in src/game/save.ts is persistence plumbing for the same behavior and was explicitly assigned to this node by the ST-06 split decision, so it is not hidden scope. The single criterion AC-art-a11y is carried verbatim from ST-06 and WI-06g is its designated final proof owner (ST-06 plan: 'AC-art-a11y: WI-06g alone'). Dependencies are correct and resolvable: WI-04b supplies the radio channel data (TRIGGER_RADIO_LINES / showRadio) the subtitles read without duplication, and WI-06d (a promoted story, so the id means all its leaves) supplies the single presentation flag owned by WI-06d-c that the shake toggle flips; neither is an ancestor or descendant. The conditional high-contrast sonar ('if easy, or a recorded cut') is permitted by section 43 itself and the verification covers both outcomes, so the boundary is not ambiguous. Evidence is focused on the behavior: per-control live browser checks, change/save/reload/assert persistence via the shared browser harness, a Node test on the save settings schema (defaults, old-save migration, round-trip), suite and build green. Boundaries are clean: presentation/state only, no new shake or flash sources (consumes WI-06d seams), no radio content authoring, no sonar redesign, no new save format (section 42 trivial migration), spoiler-safe subtitle evidence (fixtures or redaction, sections 0/12/68/70). Section 43's optional remappable controls are correctly out of scope, and the master-slider reading matches the parent's accepted scope inventory. The handoff names the specific files to inspect and the dependencies to read; a fresh implementer can proceed without reconstructing the project. Minor non-blocking note: the handoff line 'request sections 26-adjacent UI context is not needed' is garbled prose but causes no ambiguity.
